title: The Ant Line March | Kids Song, Nursery Rhymes, Counting & Teamwork for Toddlers | BuBu TV - English
description:
Follow a tiny ant line as they find a sweet laddu crumb and march together to carry it home.
This catchy rhyme teaches kids about teamwork, never leaving a friend behind, and marching in a line.
Perfect for toddlers and preschoolers who love singing along!

Left right left right, everybody march
Tiny ants in a line
Zip zip zip zip, they scurry in a row
Carrying the crumb on time!

Sugar laddu crumb has fallen
Tap tap tap, the ants are here
Hurray hurray, we found it, look!
Big sweet crumb is here!

Little ant is lost, oh no
Behind a big green leaf
Peep peep peep peep, the tiny ant looks round
Where's my line? Where's my group?

Round and round a circle forms
All the ants are calling out
Here here here here, the big ones wave their feelers
Come back to the line, little one!

Little sis and big bro watch with glee
Amma smiles and nods
Hup hup hup hup, the ants lift the crumb up high
Together they carry it home!
